inputs.goal: summarize the H1 2026 cycle for a senior engineer on the infra team

synthesize.draft_summary: The infra team delivered critical infrastructure improvements during H1 2026, focusing on cloud cost optimization and system reliability. Key achievements included reducing cloud expenses by 15% through strategic resource reallocation and implementing new monitoring tools that decreased incident response time by 25%. The team completed 85% of planned sprints with enhanced velocity metrics and maintained a 99.8% uptime across core services. Major incidents were resolved within SLA thresholds, demonstrating improved operational maturity. Capacity planning aligned with business growth targets, supporting successful deployment of new microservices architecture and automated scaling solutions.
